      04 / RESEARCH PROVENANCE
      From classroom evidence
      to an interactive exploration.
      Original work · 2022
      Client-Server based Instant Messenger. A group project presented by Yanqing Li (Lucis) and collaborators whose identities are removed in the public copy.
      The 19-slide presentation describes Vue, Node.js / Express, Socket.IO, the WebSocket handshake, and a Burp Suite message interception exercise (slides 16–17). Original source code and complete experimental data are unavailable.
      Sources · public presentation
      Privacy-redacted historical group presentation. Other student names and all student IDs have been removed; Yanqing Li (Lucis) is retained.
      Presentation PDF ↗
      This reconstruction · 2026
      A new implementation, not recovered 2022 code. All messages, attack outcomes and charts are generated by your session. No historical performance or individual contribution claims are inferred.
      TLS protects the transport, not a compromised relay after TLS terminates. End-to-end integrity detects changes but provides no confidentiality or availability. Origin validation is separate from authentication; WebSocket is not governed by ordinary CORS response headers.
      Protocol reference · RFC 6455 ↗
